_doc: The far traffic's cars (the traffic's far streets as flows: doc/port.md, traffic), on the town, in seconds: the clock run 10 s so the flows have stepped and told the render. The window of detailed traffic stands round the ground the view looks at (1100 m at its least, 1500 m at its most, its streets kept out to 1750 m), so a far car is never nearer the eye than some 1.7 km: a few pixels long. The view that shows them: the eye 4400 m west of the point it looks at (1450 m east of the town's middle), 20 degrees over the ground (camera.json far_min_tilt_deg), 0.38 px a metre at that point; the ground in the picture starts 2170 m short of the point, so its lower band is the town's west third, past the window: its streets carry the far cars, some 2300 m from the eye; above it the window's streets, whose detailed vehicles are drawn as themselves only within 900 m of the point looked at and of the eye (traffic.json publish_radius_m, agents.json vehicle_radius_m): from this eye none is, and the far cars stand in for them on those streets too; then free ground. Two shots a second apart by day show them move (the pixels that change between the two over the town), the flows' census printed (far_traffic on_far: the vehicles on the far streets, detailed: those of the window; traffic_probe drawn_far_cars: the cars written, about their sum), then one shot at 22 h (their two ends burn).
